name: GhostX
summary: Test checklist for servers that run GhostX. Written without assuming any undocumented GhostX behavior. Status stays untested until you record a result from an authorized test.

checks.title: Resource starts cleanly
checks.how: Start fmcc_control on your own test server with the anti-cheat product running. Record whether the product reports, blocks or silently ignores the resource, and whether any server console message appears.

checks.title: HTTP API reachable
checks.how: Run Diagnostics > Server status from this app. If the product filters inbound HTTP or resource endpoints, record exactly what happens.

checks.title: Client effects do not trigger actions
checks.how: Run Player > Restore health, Weapons > Give weapon and Vehicles > Spawn vehicle on a test player. Record whether the product kicks, flags or logs the player.

checks.title: Entity spawns are tolerated
checks.how: Spawn vehicles through the app within the configured limit. Record whether the product treats server-authorized spawns as suspicious.

checks.title: Integrity baseline works beside the product
checks.how: Save and check an integrity baseline (Security > Save integrity baseline, then Check integrity). Record whether file reads from the resource conflict with the product.

checks.title: Behavior after resource restart
checks.how: Restart fmcc_control and the anti-cheat resource in both orders. Record any ordering requirement you observe.
